# Marlowe signs off every allergen label before it prints

## Rule Statement

No allergen label goes to the printer until Marlowe Fenn has checked it against the recipe card.

## Enforcement

required

## Rationale

A recipe change in March reached the shelf with last month's label on it.

## Known Exceptions

None.
